meta.name: mongodb-atlas-stream-processing
meta.description: Manages MongoDB Atlas Stream Processing (ASP) workflows. Handles workspace provisioning, data source/sink connections, processor lifecycle operations, debugging diagnostics, and tier sizing. Supports Kafka, Atlas clusters, S3, HTTPS, and Lambda integrations for streaming data workloads and event processing. NOT for general MongoDB queries or Atlas cluster management. Requires MongoDB MCP Server with Atlas API credentials.

copy.tagline: 管理流式数据处理工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在MongoDB Atlas上搭建和管理流式数据处理管道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build and manage streaming data pipelines on MongoDB Atlas.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理 MongoDB Atlas 流处理工作流，包括创建和管理工作区、数据源/目标连接、处理器，以及进行调试诊断和扩容。
howto.when: 当你需要处理实时数据流（如 Kafka、Atlas 变更流、S3 等），或要求搭建、调试流处理管道时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Atlas 流处理工作区，区域选弗吉尼亚。
say.note: Claude 会调用 build 工具创建工作区。

say.text: 列出当前项目中的所有处理器及其状态。
say.note: Claude 会调用 discover 工具列出处理器。

say.text: 帮我诊断处理器 'myProcessor' 的健康状况。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage MongoDB Atlas Stream Processing workflows, including creating and managing workspaces, data source/sink connections, processors, debugging diagnostics, and tier sizing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to work with real-time data streams (e.g., Kafka, Atlas change streams, S3) or request to build, operate, or debug stream processing pipelines.

say_en.text: Create an Atlas stream processing workspace in Virginia region.
say_en.note: Claude will call the build tool to create a workspace.

say_en.text: List all processors in the current project with their status.
say_en.note: Claude will call the discover tool to list processors.
Claude will call the discover tool's diagnose action.
